title: Analysing spatial data for biodiversity conservation
summary: What Kosovo's published record can and cannot support, Earth observation as the baseline to start from, one shared system with common standards, and three working models from Czechia, Ukraine and England.

title: Condition evaluation of Natura 2000 target features
summary: The Czech site-level framework for species and habitats, run end to end through worked examples, with the weight on what the data have to look like for any of it to work.

title: Accessing and utilising GBIF data for biodiversity conservation
summary: What GBIF holds for Kosovo, the four routes into it, how to read occurrence records honestly, and five mistakes that return a plausible answer and no error message.

title: Open-source and free options for spatial data collection on biodiversity
summary: Collection tools placed on the data lifecycle, eight of them compared head to head, a decision flowchart, and the field pitfalls that cost a season.

title: Replicable and automated map and report production
summary: How this site's own tool turns occurrence records and thematic layers into a GeoPackage and a PDF report for every protected area, and what makes that repeatable rather than merely done.
